claim: The governed environment. Governance mechanisms enforce engineering obligations by acting directly on observable work or through explicit models that expose richer semantics. Durable models, mechanisms, procedures, and documentation accumulate as engineering capital.

topology.description: Mechanism enforces obligation and acts directly on observable work or reasons through explicit models; environment accumulates capital.

alt: Within a governed engineering environment, mechanisms enforce obligations and act directly on observable work or reason through explicit models. The environment accumulates engineering capital: durable models, mechanisms, procedures and documentation. Directed, labeled arrows identify these distinct relations.
